propositions: rebar-janitor's Discovery phase should consult `rebar metrics --since <date> --until <date> --output json` to cite registered code-health-lens metric values as historical trend evidence, distinct from one-shot snapshot tools.

docs/user-guide.md must document the `rebar metrics` command, its four metric lenses (agent_process/code_health/delivery/gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and the `unavailable{reason,accruing_since}` state.
examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/phases/discovery.md must instruct subagents to interpret `unavailable` as absence-of-signal rather than zero-value.
AGENTS.md 'Where to read' list must reference metrics documentation for human discoverability.
docs/reuse-surface.md must expose the `rebar.metrics` registry subsystem (MetricSpec/REGISTRY/is_authoritative) for library reuse.
